verdict.rationale: dLocal documents accepting local payment methods 'all through one platform', backed by first-party guides for Pix bank/e-wallet payments, wallet payments with enrollment-based direct charges, and a payment-method parameter on the same payment API. However, none of the specific methods named in the story (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) appears in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit Apple Pay and Google Pay support, documented bank-redirect methods, BNPL support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mixing these methods in one integration.
